review_candidates.title: AI Data Engineer
review_candidates.location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
review_candidates.description: About Millennium Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors. Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. With opportunities to deepen expertise and accelerate development, talent at Millennium is equipped to adapt, evolve and build lasting impact over time. Discover how transformative growth accelerates impact. Our Israel office is located in the Bursa area of Ramat Gan. This role is on-site. As a global firm, proficiency in English is required. Meet the Team Core to the health and growth of our business, Millennium’s Information Technology organization develops the flexible, scalable technology and advanced proprietary systems that support the firm’s multi-manager platform. The Core AI Development Team focuses on the engineering environment, data pipelines, and AI systems that help the firm apply Large Language Models in daily workflows, including enterprise retrieval and document intelligence capabilities. What You'll Do Design, build, and maintain scalable ETL and data ingestion pipelines that move documents from diverse source systems, including file shares, object stores, APIs, and databases, into the firm’s AI platform. Develop robust document understanding workflows, including parsing, layout analysis, OCR, text extraction, metadata extraction, and normalization across heterogeneous formats such as PDF, Office documents, HTML, and images. Implement chunking, cleaning, and enrichment strategies that improve retrieval quality and support downstream RAG systems. Build change-detection, deduplication, and incremental update mechanisms to keep large document corpora synchronized efficiently and reliably. Engineer pipelines for correctness, throughput, and resilience, with strong handling for malformed inputs, large files, and high-volume processing. Establish data quality checks, observability, and metrics so ingestion issues are identified early and resolved quickly. Partner with stakeholders to understand source systems and content requirements and translate them into reliable, production-ready ingestion solutions. Stay current with advances in AI, LLMs, document AI, and retrieval techniques, and apply relevant improvements to the team’s solutions. What You Bring 4+ years of experience and strong proficiency in Python, including building data pipelines, services, and APIs. Hands-on experience designing and developing ETL and data pipeline solutions, including processing large data volumes. Experience with document processing and text extraction, including PDF and Office document parsing, OCR, and unstructured content handling. Solid understanding of data modeling, transformation, and data quality best practices. Experience designing, building, testing, and debugging high-performance, reliable systems. Clear communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Familiarity with RAG systems and the impact of ingestion on retrieval quality, including chunking strategies, embeddings, and vector stores, is a plus.

review_candidates.title: Senior Software Engineer – Java / Embedded Systems / IOT
review_candidates.description: Senior Software Engineer with strong Java, Spring Boot and Kafka or distributed systems experience , alongside knowledge of IoT, embedded systems or firmware, is required to join an innovative, well-funded early-stage technology start-up developing next-generation SaaS solutions for the renewable energy sector. Location: Cambridge (but you can work remotely or hybrid if local) This is an opportunity to help design and build a scalable, cloud-native platform connecting software, data and physical energy infrastructure. We're particularly interested in Java Engineers with experience or an interest in IoT, embedded technologies and connected devices , who enjoy solving complex engineering challenges. Key skills required for the Senior Software Engineer Strong Java and Spring Boot experience , building scalable applications, APIs and microservices. Kafka or distributed systems experience , including event-driven architectures and asynchronous messaging. Good knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes , including containerisation and cloud-native deployments. Experience developing resilient, scalable SaaS applications, ideally using AWS. Strong software engineering fundamentals, automated testing and continuous delivery. Full Stack development experience, ideally with React, would be beneficial. Particularly desirable – IoT, embedded systems or connected devices: Embedded systems or firmware development , including embedded Linux environments. IoT applications , connecting sensors, hardware and physical devices to cloud platforms. Raspberry Pi or similar devices , including edge computing and IoT gateways. Communication protocols such as MQTT and Modbus (TCP/RTU) or other industrial protocols. Experience with network-connected devices, telemetry, device connectivity and data ingestion. Exposure to industrial equipment, smart meters, energy assets or connected infrastructure. Experience in one or more of these areas would be particularly attractive; you don't need to tick every box. What you'll do as a Senior Software Engineer Design and develop scalable Java / Spring Boot microservices and APIs. Build reliable distributed systems using Kafka and event-driven architectures. Develop software supporting IoT connectivity, device integration and data processing. Contribute to device-to-cloud communication and integration with connected hardware. Work with Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. Collaborate with engineers and product stakeholders on technical design, architecture and delivery. Contribute to code reviews, automated testing and continuous improvement. Why this role? Modern engineering: Work with Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, Docker, Kubernetes and cloud-native technologies. IoT and embedded technology: Opportunity to work at the intersection of software, connected devices and physical infrastructure. Technical ownership: Help shape the architecture and development of a new SaaS platform. Growing start-up: Join a recently funded technology business with significant opportunities to influence product development. Meaningful impact: Build technology supporting renewable energy and the transition to a greener future. Collaborative culture: Work alongside experienced engineers who value autonomy, technical excellence and continuous improvement. This role would particularly suit a Senior Java / Spring Boot Engineer with Kafka or distributed systems experience, knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes, and exposure to IoT, embedded systems, firmware, Raspberry Pi, MQTT or Modbus. Opus Resourcing acts as an employment agency with respect to permanent employment. 📩 Apply now or message us for more details. Referrals always welcome! #JavaDeveloper #SpringBoot #IoT #EmbeddedSystems #SoftwareEngineeringJobs
